title: Search and Rescue Information
description: Package story about U.S. Coast Guard's Search and Rescue Team, which looks for people lost or stranded at sea.  This story features District 14 based at Barber's Point as they explain some information for boaters and others going out on the water to help make the Coast Guard mission easier.
